s: Suffix used to form verbs, chiefly from other verbs, but also from nouns and adjectives. The resulting verb often has an iterative/frequentative or a diminutive meaning.
kippen (“to tilt”) + -eln → kippeln (“to tilt back and forth”)
-eln.et: From Middle High German -eln, -elen, from Old High German -alōn, from Proto-Germanic *-lōną (frequentative verbal suffix). Cognate with English -le (etymology 1), West Frisian -elje, Dutch -elen, Low German -eln, Danish -le, Swedish -la, Icelandic -la.
